lines.text: Four X tiles, four O tiles: seventy strings.
lines.caption: Four X tiles, four O tiles: seventy strings.

lines.text: Is half of them good? NOT even close!
lines.caption: Is half of them good? NOT even close!

lines.text: Read left to right. At every point, X must have at least as many as O.
lines.caption: Read left to right. At every point, X must have at least as many as O.

lines.text: Turn each string into a walk. Each X steps right, and each O steps down.
lines.caption: Turn each string into a walk. Each X steps right, and each O steps down.

lines.text: O can never pass X, so the walk never crosses this wall.
lines.caption: O can never pass X, so the walk never crosses this wall.

lines.text: Now fill in the grid. Each spot is the left number, plus the number above.
lines.caption: Now fill in the grid. Each spot is the left number, plus the number above.

lines.text: Keep adding, all the way to the corner. The answer is fourteen!
lines.caption: Keep adding, all the way to the corner. The answer is fourteen!

lines.text: That's just one string out of five!
lines.caption: That's just one string out of five!

lines.text: Why does adding work? The full lesson has a list, a table, and every trap.
lines.caption: Why does adding work? The full lesson has a list, a table, and every trap.
